title: AuditRecord
description: Append-only, hash-chained audit evidence (PRP.md section 3, PRD NS-06 'audit before/after'). Kinds: `before` (target state captured before a change), `after` (outcome and target state after), `denied` (a query, tool, export, push or action that authorization or policy refused). There is no update-capable field: no updated_at, modified_by, etag, version, status or deleted flag; corrections are new records. previous_hash is required for every record except the chain head (sequence 0), where it is null. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by `validate_audit_chain` in tests/contracts/test_schemas.py: record_hash equals sha256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of the record without record_hash; within a chain_id, sequence is contiguous from 0 and each previous_hash equals the preceding record's record_hash.

audit_id.description: Server-assigned identifier of this record (lowercase UUID).

chain_id.description: Identifier of the hash chain this record belongs to (for example one chain per domain cell).

sequence.description: Zero-based position in the chain. 0 is the chain head.

previous_hash.description: record_hash of the preceding record in the chain. Null only for the chain head (sequence 0); required otherwise.

record_hash.description: sha256 over the JCS-canonical record excluding this field.

recorded_at.description: Server-assigned, immutable instant the record was appended.

actor.description: Principal whose request produced this record.

scope_hash.description: scope_hash of the server-derived IdentityScope the request was evaluated under.

channel.description: Channel the request arrived through; null for internal workers.

intent_id.description: ActionIntent this record belongs to; null for non-action operations.

subject.description: Target and captured state. Required for before and after; null allowed for denied when no target was resolved.

outcome.description: Result of the change. Required for after; null for before and denied.

denial.description: Why the request was refused. Required for denied; null otherwise.

allOf.description: Chain head has no predecessor; every other record names one.

utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (`Z` suffix required).

target_version.description: Version or ETag observed; null when unknown.

state_digest.description: sha256 of the captured target state; null when the state could not be read.

snapshot_ref.description: Pointer to the stored, redacted snapshot used for rollback evidence; never an inline body. Null when none was stored.

result.description: Final ActionState the intent reached; mirrors the terminal states of ../../actions/v1/action-state.schema.json.

verified.description: True only when the actual change on the target was read back and matched (no catalog-only pretend changes).

code.description: Error taxonomy code. Mirrors errors/v1 (authoritative); `validate_denial_codes_match_error_taxonomy` in tests/contracts/test_error_taxonomy.py keeps the two lists equal.
